**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Anna ](../persons.html#195)
I am only just in time to catch the post and thank you very much for the photographs.

The outside of the house is charming, and [Annie Moberly](../persons.html#1024) is venturing to ask if she might have one of them and of the group.

She and [Miss Price](../persons.html#1209) came out exactly like and she is like half her sisters.

She would like them unmounted. I shall be very glad to see you when you make another attempt on the garden side, but I shall be out on Friday week probably on the Thursday and on the Friday

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Perhaps associated with the photograph by Bramston of CMY aged 75, illustrated in Coleridge, [Life](../others.html#40), facing p 280.
